description: A toggle switch (DESIGN.md, Switch): a 48 × 28 track, a 24 thumb 2 from the edge, sliding over TsuyaDuration.fast. Off: TsuyaColors.borderStrong track, TsuyaColors.thumb thumb; on: the accent track, TsuyaColors.onAccent thumb. Applies at once, with no save step. Named by label, or by the caller's row (wrapped in its own `MergeSemantics`: a plain ListItem does it for its trailing switch) when it is null.

params.name: onChanged
params.description: Called with the next value on a press; null disables it.

params.name: label
params.description: Beside the track, TsuyaSpace.s12 away, in body; when null, the caller's row names it instead (a plain ListItem does), and anywhere else it needs a name from a `Semantics` around it.

params.name: focusNode
params.description: The node to track focus with, when the caller manages one.

params.name: autofocus
params.description: Focuses it as soon as it is built.
